inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Five children did not have current immunizations. One was missing their 15 month immunizations, four children are missing their 6m - 18m immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During an investigation inspection  walk through, the television in the infant room was on.    Corrected at inspection when a caregiver turned it off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was found to be out of compliance when children were told to do wall squats or run laps as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Infant caregiver has not updated her SIDS, shaken bay syndrome, and early childhood brain development training. It expired February 2026
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: An infant caregiver was alone with nine infants under 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: This standard was found to be out of compliance when a caregiver used corporal punishment to redirect a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver on conditional status was left alone with children. occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to report the number of employees who left in 2025 by January 15, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Transportation training: A volunteer who provides transportation has not completed the annual transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1403(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Fire inspection expired in July 2025.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: I observed a caregiver by herself with children between the ages of 0-11 months of age. There were 5 children present. This was corrected when another caregiver went to help.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Caregiver in the room with  children that are 0-12 months of age had 5 children present. This was corrected when another caregiver went into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The cabinet under the bathroom sink had cleaning products. These were accessible to children as the safety lock in the cabinet was not working properly. The cabinet could easily be opened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A piece of outdoor play equipment was broken and had sharp edges.   This was corrected at inspection when it was removed from the outdoor area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: A group of children ate their lunch without washing their hands prior.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: I observed the infant room caregiver walk out of the room, leaving the child in the room unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Cots that are used are not labeled.
